latest_release.name: Version 5.4.0
latest_release.body:
- Make the Docker workers run on older PHP versions and without a host database [[#413](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/413)]
- Leave files of the scenario out of the installation cache [[#411](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/411)]
- Declare and check the commands that scenarios need [[#410](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/410)]
- Report the scenarios that are left out, and why [[#409](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/409)]
- Run parallel workers in throwaway Docker containers [[#408](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/408)]
- Add a step for scenarios that need a specific set of themes [[#406](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/406)]
- Run scenarios in parallel workers [[#405](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/405)]
- Reuse plugins and themes downloaded from WordPress.org across scenarios [[#404](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/404)]
- Trim fixed per-scenario overhead [[#403](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/403)]
- Launch WP-CLI processes with cheaper PHP settings [[#401](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/401)]
- Add a step to run several setup commands in a single process [[#400](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/400)]
- Make the run time report work again [[#399](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/399)]
- Provide plugin and theme directories as built-in variables [[#397](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/397)]
- Remove roave/security-advisories [[#396](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/396)]
